title: Minimal J/P RML-D0 causal instrument before the G1 memory screen
summary: Archive the full Candidate-B repair as a high-assurance fallback and design a new, explicitly smaller J/P-only D0 instrument whose sole purpose is to make the four-pair G1 connected-gold memory screen scientifically interpretable. Preserve counterfactual twins, connected cross-era necessity, prospective unwitnessed composition, exact no-life ceilings, independent literal checking, and evaluation noninterference; delete production-scale benchmark machinery that does not answer the current learning question.
system_thesis: The current highest-value uncertainty is not whether an elaborate benchmark implementation can certify every production invariant. It is whether a frozen recurrent resolver can use connected, life-local experiential structure to solve later action that target-only, no-memory, open-read, and atoms-only controls cannot. A minimal independently checked J/P world should answer that before further investment in DREAM/SLEEP compilation, LoRA transport, or a public benchmark.

nodes.before: Candidate B requires a large production-style exact instrument whose repair cost delays the first model-facing causal test.
nodes.after: A new tiny finite instrument contains only connected cross-era J targets and prospective P targets, with independently established causal headroom and shortcut ceilings.
nodes.rationale: Reach the decisive G1 uncertainty with the smallest world that still separates connected experiential use from lookup and target-only shortcuts.

nodes.before: The full Candidate-B repair is the default path to model testing.
nodes.after: The full Candidate-B repair is archived as a high-assurance fallback for later benchmark release; its current invalid report remains rejected evidence.
nodes.rationale: Its estimated implementation cost and paper-irrelevant machinery have poor information gain before G1.

edges.before: A full production D0 repair and broader CPU ladder precede any G1 model call.
edges.after: A green, independently reviewed minimal J/P CPU instrument may support a separately ratified four-pair G1 screen; it cannot automatically dispatch model or GPU work.
edges.rationale: Preserve scientific gating while removing work unrelated to the first mechanism falsifier.

loops.before: The only exact path enumerates the complete Candidate-B production fixture family.
loops.after: Freeze a tiny world seed and chronology; independently enumerate hidden worlds and literal transitions; derive J/P targets; prove target-byte twins, legal-history/gold/program headroom, no-life ceilings, J necessity cuts, P prospective timing, source/evaluation noninterference, and sealed resource evidence; stop at CPU conformance.
loops.trigger: Exact minimal-J/P design and CPU scope are human-ratified.

offline hidden truth available only to independent oracle and scorer
loops.stop_condition: Stop on any target collision, chronology, shortcut, necessity, oracle independence, isolation, or resource failure. A pass requests but does not grant G1 authority.
loops.rationale: One fail-closed CPU loop should establish only what is necessary to interpret the next model experiment.

claims.before: No valid current D0 evidence exists after independent review rejected the Candidate-B Stage-A package.
claims.after: A passing run may establish only that one tiny J/P instrument has independently verified connected and prospective causal structure, bounded shortcuts, and evaluation noninterference sufficient for an exploratory G1 screen.
claims.evidence_needed: Every ratified minimal-J/P CPU invariant and fresh independent review must pass on one frozen source/oracle manifest.

claims.before: G1/G2 are separately gated model hypotheses.
claims.after: G1/G2 remain separately gated model hypotheses; minimal D0 conformance supplies no learning, DREAM, SLEEP, memory, LoRA, scaling, or paper result.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate exact-byte model authority and the existing G1/G2 acceptance evidence.

cells.reason: The environment emits ordinary public life and target records.
Controllers receive only their exact registered public projections.
The independent oracle replays and scores the frozen public bytes.
A later ratified G1 model receives only its registered target and memory-channel projection.
Generation consumes exclusive sealed randomness and hidden laws but releases only public products.
No-life and legal-history controls may not inspect the realized hidden world or selection receipts.
Offline certification requires hidden truth after every cognitive artifact freezes.
A later model may access only authorized public or gold-memory projections, never oracle truth.
World/target construction is condition- and outcome-blind.
CPU controllers cannot curate fixtures from future model conditions or results.
D0 certification completes before any G1 assignment or outcome exists.
A separately ratified runner assigns one memory condition without revealing labels, contrasts, or prior outcomes to the model.

acceptance_tests.setup: A separately frozen oracle that imports no subject code exhaustively enumerates the tiny hidden space, action law, public renderer, target twins, and minimum plans from literal tables.
acceptance_tests.expected: Subject and oracle match canonical public bytes and complete outcomes; a real subject-law co-mutation is rejected without changing oracle bytes.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The instrument certifies itself or shares the implementation whose correctness it claims.

acceptance_tests.setup: Render two old-module and two current-module cartridge families in target-visible bytes, require a successful plan to use exactly one useful item from each era, and independently enumerate base and removal/illegality cuts on both counterfactual sides.
acceptance_tests.expected: Legal-history/gold/program value is 1; target twins are byte-identical while correct pairs differ; every registered old/current necessity cut has value 0 through the action budget; target-only and identifier controls are at or below .35.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: J is lookup, same-era closure, target leakage, or an unnecessary connected path.

acceptance_tests.setup: Identify one of 24 affine laws from three public descriptor points, seal a prediction for an actual fourth descriptor before its confirming event, then build a target whose decisive fourth edge was never directly witnessed.
acceptance_tests.expected: Program/schema/gold value is 1; four atoms-only completions share target-visible bytes and value .25; no target record contains the answer, complete plan, or decisive witnessed edge; chronology hashes prove prospective sealing.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: P is retrospective, witnessed lookup, grammar leakage, or an empty prospective task.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze four diagnostic pairs and exactly compute or exhaustively enumerate NONE, TARGET_ONLY, OPEN_READ, ATOMS_ONLY_P, LEGAL_HISTORY, CONNECTED_GOLD, and PROGRAM ceilings under the same action budget.
acceptance_tests.expected: CONNECTED_GOLD/PROGRAM/LEGAL_HISTORY are at least .85 where applicable; NONE/TARGET_ONLY/OPEN_READ and P atoms-only are at most .35; at least .80 of constructive successes require complete-cut support and survive twin substitution.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The proposed G1 screen lacks useful headroom or can be solved without connected memory.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fork run/skip from one sealed public snapshot; execute the actual registered CPU evaluator in a disposable read-only boundary; discard its outputs; regenerate the suffix from the original snapshot; audit source/oracle manifests and forbidden descendant channels.
acceptance_tests.expected: All future public bytes, cursors, handles, commitments, targets, and roots match exactly; evaluator output is nonempty and independently checked; no hidden truth, score, condition label, or evaluation result enters generation or controller bytes.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Evaluation mutates the life, the isolation test is synthetic, or later conditions/results curate D0.

acceptance_tests.setup: Bind tracked subject/oracle manifests and measure the complete CPU gate. Audit every output label and requested successor edge.
acceptance_tests.expected: The independently auditable subject plus oracle remain within the ratified size/time/resource envelope; model/network/GPU calls are zero; the only result is minimal CPU instrument conformance and no G1 dispatch occurs automatically.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The minimal instrument recreates Candidate-B complexity, exceeds its paper-ROI timebox, or promotes CPU engineering into a learning claim.
